hero.title: Template standards
hero.description: Operational standards and migration guidance for the template. Each pattern page below includes its own live example.

status.label: Status:
status.text: Standards are maintained in this hub. Changes should include a standards update and migration notes.

adoptablePets.title: Adoptable Pets Pattern
adoptablePets.description: Unified adoptable pets shell with provider adapters and fallback behavior.

dogSpotlight.title: Dog Spotlight Pattern
dogSpotlight.description: Homepage grid highlighting a hand-curated set of dogs, four across on desktop.

found.title: Found Pattern
found.description: Found notices module with safe-reunification checklist, status filtering, and CTA guidance.

placement.title: Placement Pattern
placement.description: Placement listings with default three-month expiry and optional pet metadata.

eventsNews.title: Events & News Pattern
eventsNews.description: Unified event/news feed with archive behavior, recurrence support, and banner guidance.

newsHighlight.title: Home Highlight Pattern
newsHighlight.description: Homepage card that surfaces a single editor-flagged event, news entry, or blog post via the shared HomeHighlightSection component.

blog.title: Blog Pattern
blog.description: Shared post list and post-detail pattern covering both tech guides and rescue-story content with real photos.

journeyTimeline.title: Journey Timeline Pattern
journeyTimeline.description: Vertical rescue-to-today timeline for an individual dog's detail page, one card per stage.

successStories.title: Success Stories Pattern
successStories.description: Narrative story-card module for adoption outcomes and happy tails.

testimonials.title: Testimonials Pattern
testimonials.description: Featured and grid testimonial patterns for reusable social-proof sections.

flyerLibrary.title: Flyer Library Pattern
flyerLibrary.description: Timeless, undated awareness flyer library with category filtering — distinct from dated events/news.

mediaGallery.title: Media Gallery Pattern
mediaGallery.description: Unified photo/video gallery with optional filtering and no-JS-safe rendering.

faqAccordion.title: FAQ Accordion Pattern
faqAccordion.description: Canonical FAQ content schema, i18n data pattern, and derived JSON-LD requirement.

faq.title: FAQ Pattern
faq.description: Native `<details>/<summary>` requirement for public FAQ/disclosure content.

formEmbedModal.title: FormEmbedModal Standard
formEmbedModal.description: Provider-agnostic form modal pattern with helper and no-JS fallbacks.

paypalButtons.title: PayPal Buttons Pattern
paypalButtons.description: Two incompatible PayPal button products (Donate Button vs Hosted Buttons) — pick the mode matching the org's real button.

zeffyDonate.title: Zeffy Donate Pattern
zeffyDonate.description: Zeffy donation form embed with a no-JS-safe working fallback as the default state.

communityPartners.title: Community Partners Pattern
communityPartners.description: Thanking rescue collaborators and local business supporters without implying favoritism.

supporterRecognition.title: Supporter Recognition Pattern
supporterRecognition.description: A flat, unranked thank-you list for individual donors and supporters.

impactStats.title: Impact Stats Pattern
impactStats.description: Lifetime impact stat tiles plus an optional period-by-period bar chart for rescue-organization impact reporting.

spendBreakdown.title: Spend Breakdown Pattern
spendBreakdown.description: Rolled-up spend category tiles for accountability reporting, composable with Impact Stats without being merged into it.

impactAccountability.title: Impact & Accountability
impactAccountability.description: Worked example composing Impact Stats and Spend Breakdown together on one page, plus links to each pattern on its own.

kennelDisplayTools.title: Kennel & Display Tools Pattern
kennelDisplayTools.description: Standalone full-viewport print/kiosk tools: adoptable slideshow and 2-up kennel card/binder print sheets.

documents.title: Documents Pattern
documents.description: Print-ready adoption certificate, medical record, and generic document wrapper, plus the /documents index.

buildValidation.title: Build & Validation
buildValidation.description: Build, preview, no-JS preview, and link-check commands.

ciBuild.title: CI Build Workflow
ciBuild.description: Minimal GitHub Actions install/build guard and sync approach.

noJsFallbacks.title: No-JS Fallbacks
noJsFallbacks.description: Review checklist for `js-only`, `<noscript>`, and duplicate fallback cleanup.
